Cancelling your booking 
Passenger Cancellation Policy 
Passenger Cancellation Policy 
 Updated today 
Table of contents 
🇨🇦  · Applies to Canada only · Click here for US version 
If you are a passenger and need to cancel a booking, our Passenger Cancellation Policy applies. 
When you withdraw a booking request or it expires 
You get a 100% refund. 
The booking fee is also refunded. 
When you cancel a booking less than 24 hours before departure 
You get a 50% refund (minus the booking fee). 
The driver gets 50% of the seat price as compensation. 
An automatic "late cancellation" review is added to your profile. 
Notes: 
If the driver subsequently cancels the trip, you will receive another refund for the remaining 50% (without the booking fee). 
In rare cases, our Support Team may review a cancellation before departure and issue a full refund at their discretion. Please cancel your booking in the app first, then contact us if you believe this applies to your situation. 
When you cancel a booking more than 24 hours before departure 
You get a full refund (minus the booking fee). 
When you don’t show up 
You do not get a refund, see our Passenger No-show Policy. 
When the driver cancels your trip 
You get a 100% refund, including the booking fee, see our Driver Cancellation Policy. 
Only applies to approved bookings. For late cancellations see: When you cancel a booking less than 24 hours before departure above.
